Fields of Honor


TrainersPokemonItemsMax Raid Battles


Wild Area?: Yes
North Exit: Soothing Wetlands
South Exit: Workout Sea
Access To: Master Dojo, Courageous Cavern

Bike Lady
Near the Dojo, you will find the Bike Lady. She will allow for you to switch between the Glistening Black and Sparkling White Rotom Bikes as well as the standard bike

Partner Cap:
If you show the lady in the Station a Zarude, you will receive a special Partner Cap

Available Weather
Normal Weather, Overcast, Rain, Thunderstorm, Sandstorm, Intense Sun, Fog

This area is only available for players who purchased the Pokémon Sword & Shield Expansion Pass
